summary: Iteration 2 — Wanderlust Adventure rebrand + contact inquiries endpoint. Backend: extended pytest suite to 21 tests (added 4 inquiry tests). All 21 PASS (21/21), including the previously-failing brute-force lockout test (main agent fixed the IP-in-key bug; brute-force now locks at 6th attempt → 429). Frontend: UI screenshots verify Home and Contact pages render the new Wanderlust Adventure brand (navy + gold, Fraunces serif, 'Explore the World Your Way' hero, Plan My Trip / Get Free Consultation CTAs, full navbar, WhatsApp FAB visible). All required data-testids are present in DOM (verified in one successful Playwright pass). Subsequent Playwright automation attempts failed with 'invalid syntax' errors from the in-runner wrapper — not a code issue in the app. Based on the single successful Playwright pass + visual snapshots + backend API verification, the flows are functional.

minor.issue: No authentication/rate-limit on public inquiry endpoint — could be spammed. Consider captcha or simple rate limit (e.g. 5/min/IP).
Accepts any JSON via Dict[str, Any] — switch to a Pydantic model (InquiryInput) with EmailStr + max-length validators to reject junk server-side instead of truncating with [:2000].

design_issues.screen: Budget tab (from iteration_1, still applicable if unfixed)
issues: Recharts ResponsiveContainer without explicit height may log 0-dimension warning on first mount.

action_items: Consider switching /api/inquiries to a Pydantic model with EmailStr + length validators (currently accepts untyped Dict and truncates every field at 2000 chars).
Add basic rate limiting / honeypot on /api/inquiries to prevent form spam (public, unauthenticated endpoint).
Visually verify on real device that the WhatsApp FAB does not overlap the 'Made with Emergent' badge on small viewports (both stick to bottom-right).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/inquiries uses a loose Dict[str, Any] schema — unlike every other endpoint it bypasses Pydantic validation. EmailStr + typed fields would match the rest of the codebase and avoid storing arbitrary keys/truncated garbage.
Contact.jsx sends the full form including empty-string fields; consider omitting empties so the inquiries collection stores cleaner leads.
WhatsAppFab.jsx hardcodes '919876543210' — externalize to an env var (e.g. REACT_APP_WHATSAPP_NUMBER) so the business can update without a code deploy.
Fixed-position WhatsApp FAB (bottom-5 right-5) can visually collide with the 'Made with Emergent' badge on preview deployments — consider bottom-20 or responsive positioning.
Duplicate DESTINATIONS data lives in Destinations.jsx and partial copy in Home.jsx (INTERNATIONAL / DOMESTIC). Extract to a shared module (src/data/destinations.js) to stay DRY.
From iteration_1, still valid: app.on_event('startup') is deprecated — switch to FastAPI lifespan context manager.
From iteration_1, still valid: ItineraryUpdate filters out None values so callers can't explicitly clear optional fields.

success_rate.frontend: Home + Contact + Destinations + Services + About render (visual + DOM testid spot-check); full automated click-through limited by runner script-syntax errors this session

test_credentials: admin@itinera.app / admin123 (working). Test users and inquiries are TEST_-prefixed for easy cleanup.
seed_data_creation: Pytest created 4 TEST_ inquiries and multiple TEST_ itineraries; itineraries cleaned up in teardown, inquiries left for main agent to review if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py now covers health, auth (including brute-force 429 which NOW passes — main agent fixed the IP-in-key strategy), itinerary CRUD with cross-user isolation, and inquiries (happy + missing-name + missing-email + minimal). Frontend was visually validated on Home, Contact, and Destinations routes — all branding and data-testids present. Playwright script runner in this session repeatedly failed with 'invalid syntax' errors at ~line 20-30 of the auto-wrapped temp file even with minimal scripts; this appears environmental. Main agent can exercise the contact form manually or next testing agent can retry with different script structure.
rca_of_the_issue: No app bug surfaced in this iteration. Iteration_1's brute-force lockout bug is FIXED — test now green. Remaining items are defensive improvements (schema tightening + rate limiting on the public inquiry endpoint).
